focus: City of Phoenix (Downtown, Central Phoenix along Camelback and Indian School, Arcadia-area East Camelback, North Phoenix from 16th St and 19th Ave up to Deer Valley and Desert Ridge, Paradise Valley-area Tatum Blvd, West Phoenix along 43rd Ave, Peoria Ave, and 83rd Ave, South Phoenix along Baseline Rd, and Ahwatukee)
intro: This first Phoenix page covers 20 UPS Store locations with Phoenix street addresses whose official location and mailbox-services pages list staffed hours and package acceptance from all carriers — from Downtown and Central Phoenix to North Phoenix, Desert Ridge, West Phoenix, South Phoenix, and Ahwatukee. 19 of them publish Sunday hours, and three (24 W Camelback Rd, 3039 West Peoria Ave, and 4802 E Ray Rd) stay open until 7:00 or 8:00 PM on weekdays. None of these stores says on its own page that mailbox holders get round-the-clock access; they mention 24-hour access only at participating locations, so that flag is off for all of them. No mailbox prices are published on these pages. It is not a complete inventory: independent pack-and-ship stores, USPS Premium PO Boxes, and nearby cities such as Scottsdale, Tempe, Mesa, Chandler, and Glendale are not covered yet. Box availability can change; treat it as something to confirm. If you cannot get to a storefront, compare virtual mailbox services.

listings.name: The UPS Store — 125 N 2nd St Ste 110

hours.notes: Staffed store hours from the official location page’s opening-hours data. Holiday hours can differ; the page lists Thanksgiving Day (November 26) as closed.

listings.carriersNotes: The official mailbox-services page for this store says mailbox customers get package acceptance from all carriers, plus mail holding and forwarding. It does not list carrier names. Confirm any size or signing limits with the store.
listings.visitNotes: The mailbox-services page lists “24-hour access (at participating locations),” which does not confirm after-hours lobby access at this store. Box availability is not published as live inventory. Confirm with the store that a box is actually open.
